decisions.headline: 《最终幻想VII：启示》总监称完整体验可轻松超过100小时
decisions.summary: 总监滨口直树在采访中表示，如果从头到尾检查游戏中的每项资产和内容，一轮流程会轻松超过100小时；他也透露自己仍在出差等间隙持续检查最新开发版本。
decisions.verification: IGN已打开并转述滨口直树在GameSpot采访中的直接表述；时长信息保留为开发者个人描述，不作为独立测算结论。
decisions.reason: 大体量作品的总监访谈提供明确开发进度与体量信息，达到“可以，但不是必须”阈值。
decisions.timeNote: IGN发布时间已换算为北京时间并位于本期固定窗口内。

decisions.headline: 小岛秀夫详谈Sony终止《PHYSINT》合作经过，并称曾担心工作室陷入危机
decisions.summary: 小岛秀夫在IGN采访中回忆，Sony于今年6月的Zoom会议中通知其退出《PHYSINT》项目并停止资金支持；他一度担心团队去留、银行关系与工作室经营，随后向Xbox提出方案并让项目获得新的发行支持。
decisions.verification: IGN已打开，该文为小岛秀夫在PlayStation退出《PHYSINT》后的专访；正文直接支持会议、资金终止、经营担忧与后续向Xbox寻求支持等表述。
decisions.reason: 涉及大型项目发行关系变化的核心当事人首次详细说明，属于本期高价值产业采访。
decisions.timeNote: IGN发布时间已换算为北京时间并位于本期固定窗口内。

decisions.headline: 东京电玩展2026四日总到场257,642人，第五日因台风取消
decisions.summary: CESA公布东京电玩展2026线下四日总到场人数为257,642人。受台风25号影响，原定9月21日举行的第五日线下活动取消，因此本届实际以9月17日至20日四日会期收官。
decisions.verification: Famitsu报道与CESA官方新闻稿相互印证；CESA于2026年9月20日21:50（日本时间）公布四日总到场人数及第五日取消信息。
decisions.reason: TGS 2026收官数据与会期变更属于重要行业信息，达到强烈建议收录级别。
decisions.timeNote: CESA官方新闻稿发布时间为日本时间2026年9月20日21:50，换算为北京时间20:50。

decisions.headline: 《Castlevania: Belmont’s Curse》试玩版10月1日上线，存档可继承至正式版
decisions.summary: Konami、Evil Empire与Motion Twin确认《Castlevania: Belmont’s Curse》试玩版将于10月1日推出，试玩存档可继承至正式版；正式版计划10月15日登陆PS5、Xbox Series、Switch与PC。
decisions.verification: Gematsu已打开并转述发行商与开发团队公告，试玩日期、存档继承与正式版平台均由正文支持。
decisions.reason: 知名系列试玩版节点及存档继承信息明确，达到建议收录级别。
decisions.timeNote: Gematsu发布时间已换算为北京时间并位于本期固定窗口内。

decisions.headline: 日本游戏大奖2026 Future Division公布10款获奖作品
decisions.summary: CESA公布日本游戏大奖2026 Future Division的10款获奖作品。该奖项面向东京电玩展2026中展出或发表的未发售作品，由一般投票与评审委员会选出，获奖名单包括《最终幻想VII：启示》《Persona 4 Revival》等。
decisions.verification: 4Gamer报道与CESA官方新闻稿相互印证；CESA于2026年9月20日16:30（日本时间）公布10款Future Division获奖作品。
decisions.reason: TGS期间的重要行业奖项结果，信息密度与关注度均达到强烈建议收录级别。
decisions.timeNote: CESA官方新闻稿发布时间为日本时间2026年9月20日16:30，换算为北京时间15:30。

entries.headline: Stellar Blade Complete Edition Switch 2 demo launches alongside Bayonetta collaboration details
entries.summary: SHIFT UP launched the Switch 2 demo for Stellar Blade Complete Edition and also revealed four Bayonetta collaboration outfits that will be offered free across Switch 2, PC and PS5.
entries.verification: The opened 4Gamer report relays the TGS 2026 stage and Nintendo eShop information.
entries.timeNote: The source supports a September 20 date and the packet classifies the event inside the fixed window; no exact timestamp is available.

entries.headline: Life-sim MMO Loftia enters Early Access on November 3
entries.summary: Qloud Games announced that Loftia will enter Early Access on November 3, 2026. The life-sim MMO focuses on living across floating islands without combat or competition.
entries.verification: The opened 4Gamer report relays Qloud Games' announcement.
entries.timeNote: The source supports a September 21 announcement date and the packet classifies it inside the fixed window; no exact timestamp is available.

entries.headline: Final Fantasy VII Revelation director says a completionist run can easily exceed 100 hours
entries.summary: Director Naoki Hamaguchi said that checking every asset and element from start to finish can easily push a playthrough beyond 100 hours, while noting that he continues reviewing the latest build even during business trips.
entries.verification: The opened IGN report relays Hamaguchi's comments from a GameSpot interview.
entries.timeNote: IGN's timestamp converts to 04:52 Beijing time on September 21, inside the fixed window.

entries.headline: Hideo Kojima details Sony's exit from PHYSINT and says he feared for the studio
entries.summary: In an IGN interview, Hideo Kojima said Sony informed him in June that it was ending its PHYSINT involvement and funding. He described concerns about staffing, financing and the studio's future before pitching the project to Xbox.
entries.verification: The opened IGN article is a direct interview with Hideo Kojima.
entries.timeNote: IGN's timestamp converts to 19:00 Beijing time on September 20, inside the fixed window.

entries.headline: Tokyo Game Show 2026 draws 257,642 visitors across four days as day five is cancelled
entries.summary: CESA reported 257,642 visitors across the four in-person days of Tokyo Game Show 2026. The planned fifth day on September 21 was cancelled because of Typhoon No. 25.
entries.verification: The opened Famitsu report is corroborated by CESA's official September 20 release.
entries.timeNote: CESA published the official release at 21:50 JST on September 20, or 20:50 Beijing time.

entries.headline: Castlevania: Belmont's Curse demo launches October 1 with save transfer
entries.summary: Konami, Evil Empire and Motion Twin will release a demo on October 1, with save data transferable to the full game launching October 15 on PS5, Xbox Series, Switch and PC.
entries.verification: The opened Gematsu report relays the publisher and developers' announcement.
entries.timeNote: Gematsu's timestamp converts to 14:35 Beijing time on September 20, inside the fixed window.

entries.headline: Dynasty Warriors 3: Complete Edition Remastered demo launches September 24
entries.summary: Koei Tecmo and Omega Force announced a September 24 demo. The full game launches October 1 on PS5, Xbox Series, Switch 2 and PC, with online two-player play planned in a free update by January 2027.
entries.verification: The opened Gematsu report relays Koei Tecmo and Omega Force's announcement.
entries.timeNote: Gematsu's timestamp converts to 11:30 Beijing time on September 20, inside the fixed window.

entries.headline: Japan Game Awards 2026 names 10 Future Division winners
entries.summary: CESA announced 10 Future Division winners selected from unreleased works shown or announced at Tokyo Game Show 2026 through public voting and jury review, including Final Fantasy VII Revelation and Persona 4 Revival.
entries.verification: The opened 4Gamer report is corroborated by CESA's official release.
entries.timeNote: CESA published the official release at 16:30 JST on September 20, or 15:30 Beijing time.
